description: Zone Overlays turned on in the Video overlays panel, with NFZs drawn in red and the Geofence in green on the live video.
The Video overlays panel open at the bottom-right of the video, with the Zone overlays toggle.
Red shaded NFZs with name and distance labels and a green Geofence outline on the live video.
The NFZ eye icon turned off, so only the green Geofence outline remains on the video.
The Geofence eye icon turned off, so only the red NFZs remain on the video.
A red glow growing on the edge of the video as the drone approaches an NFZ, while the zone blinks on the map.
A red edge glow, an NFZ label with an arrow and distance at the top of the video, and the matching zone blinking on the map.
The Zone proximity warnings toggle in the Video overlays panel.
A person drawing a circle and placing symbols on the live video, seen by everyone viewing the drone.
The Live annotations toggle in the Video overlays panel.
The Live Annotation toolbar open above the pen button, with Freehand selected.
A freehand circle drawn around an object on the live video, labeled with the author's name.
A direction arrow drawn on the live video.
The Place a symbol menu listing Point of interest, Person, Vehicle and Hazard.
Person and Vehicle symbols placed on the live video.
The ink color menu with Red, Orange, Amber, Green and Blue.
The Remove my marks for everyone button showing a tick after the marks are removed.
A right-click on the ground in the video, the Go to Location panel, the launch and the target pin as the drone flies there.
The right-click menu on the live video showing Go to location and the distance from the drone.
The Go to Location panel with Latitude and Longitude filled in from the selected point.
The Launch button in the Go to Location panel.
The target pin fixed to the ground on the live video, showing the remaining distance and altitude.
